'''Melvor Khamp''' was an individual from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] during the time prior of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Khamp was stationed in the [[Sluis Van Shipyards]] when the Empire attacked his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], in what became known as the [[Sixty Hour War]], and Khamp's entire family were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Following the attack, Khamp returned to Derilyn, and after learning of his family's fate, he disappeared into Derilyn's underworld community and eventually became a member of the [[Friends of Paran]], an anti-Imperial resistance group. After joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as well, Khamp became a resident of the [[Friends of Paran base]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Knellis]]. There, he tasked some Rebel agents and several Friends of Paran operatives to infiltrate Derilyn's [[Imperial Monitoring Garrison]], to steal [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] regarding [[Operation: Elrood]]. Using the data that was gathered in the raid, Khamp subsequently sent the Rebels to [[Battle of Derilyn|board]] the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]''.
